Container.Name: MSF Docker
Container.Overview: MSF Docker is a free, open-source, TUN-only DNS and proxy gateway that manages MosDNS and Mihomo through one WebUI. The recommended Unraid deployment gives the container a dedicated LAN IPv4 address on br0.
Container.Description: MSF combines MosDNS DNS routing with Mihomo TUN proxying and provides setup, provider, rule, service, traffic, and status management in one WebUI. This Docker application uses macvlan-tun mode and requires a dedicated LAN IPv4 address, /dev/net/tun, NET_ADMIN, and NET_RAW. After setup, point the router DHCP DNS and the FakeIP static route to the container IP. Persistent application data is stored under /mnt/user/appdata/msf-docker by default. Container updates are managed from Unraid Docker rather than the in-app updater.
Container.Requires: Requires an Unraid custom LAN network such as br0, a dedicated static LAN IPv4 address, and an available /dev/net/tun device. Router DHCP DNS and FakeIP routes must be configured separately.
